description: Consumo de energía y emisión de GEI is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Minería. Consumo de energía y emisión de Gases de Efecto Invernadero (GEI). Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Minería. Its tags are GEI, gases efecto invernadero. It offers 17 resource(s) in CSV, XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-05-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
